## Claim discipline
- [ ] I did not silently weaken the conclusion or strengthen assumptions.
- [ ] Any semantic statement change resets the hypothesis to `SPEC_DRAFT` and is re-frozen.
- [ ] I do not describe the result as novel unless the literature evidence and human novelty sign-off support that status.
- [ ] Generated/agent-authored work is identified in the research record where relevant.

## Evidence changed
List files under `reviews/`, `lit/`, `proofs/`, `reports/`, or the Lean source that changed.

## Adversarial check
What is the strongest reason this result may be wrong, trivial, circular, mis-specified, or already known?

## Reviewer notes
Do not approve merely because `lake build` passes. Review the mathematical statement and evidence appropriate to this PR stage.
